name: 蔡佳玟
objective:
本課程以手繪為核心設計表現工具，培養學生對形體、比例、材質與操作關係的基本理解。課程由基礎線條與設計表現技法訓練出發，逐步強化產品平面與立體圖的手繪能力，引導學生將設計想法轉化為具體且清楚的視覺表達成果。

This course uses hand drawing as a core tool for design representation, aiming to develop students’ fundamental understanding of form, proportion, material, and operational relationships. Starting with basic line exercises and design representation techniques, the course progressively strengthens students’ abilities to draw planar and three-dimensional product representations, guiding them to transform design ideas into clear and concrete visual outcomes.
